sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Rust: crates/harnesses/src/spawn.rs (argv/launch), crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs spawn wait and structured failure details, crates/core/src/model.rs additive envelope details, crates/cli/src/client.rs/main.rs details preservation, crates/daemon/src/registration.rs bind evidence/model truth, and crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs for terminal delivery only when tombstoned or successfully observed pane-absent plus socket-unreachable. Keep the wire additive: new fields, no renames.

value.name: the unit
value.paths: crates/harnesses/src/spawn.rs, crates/harnesses/src/lib.rs, crates/core/src/model.rs (additive Envelope.details only), crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs (spawn wait/failure only), crates/daemon/src/http/types.rs (SpawnRequest, SpawnResponse, Registration actual model evidence), crates/daemon/src/registration.rs (bind notification, model truth, parent preservation), crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs (tombstoned-or-observed-dead terminal policy with socket and unknown states), crates/testkit/src/fakes.rs (pane/composer/inventory/reachability facts), crates/cli/src/client.rs (preserve envelope details), crates/cli/src/main.rs (spawn output), .pi/extensions/pij/index.ts, .pi/extensions/pij/adapters/rust-runtime.ts, .pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon-wire.ts, tests
value.test_strategy: RED-first; every new test proven red on the pre-fix tree, output pasted.

value.note: Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: build; tests; harness checks (symlink canonical node_modules; req-0044 baseline reds excluded by name); live proof; PR.

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps

value.text: Keep to the named paths; ask prime before widening.
